title: קרן אל-ביט

spec.palette: designed ramps, at most 5 steps each: copper 5, teal 4, bottle 4, glow 3, hot 2, ivory 2, mark 1

source: hand-placed pixels at 0 deg, every column (tools/art_host/weapons/beam_px.py); rows turned RotSprite-style (Scale2x x3, nearest), stray pixels out, a 1 px outline; the mark upright in the overlay only
character:
WHO: a worn copper cutting rifle: a fat RIBBED COIL at the front with a glowing lens mouth, orange heat fins on the
       copper receiver, a dark teal steel back and skeleton stock, a grey gas bottle hanging under it on a hose, and an
       ivory RULER plate on its side (it cuts rock the way a ministry cuts a budget: straight across, by the ruler).
  IDLE: the lens breathes a thin green flicker and every second the mouth spits a spark that drops to the floor; the
        bottle swings a pixel. FIRE: the current runs down the coil in green rings to a white-green lens and the bottle
        swings. OVERHEAT (its reload show): the coil goes red-hot, the gauge needle slams to red, steam bursts from the
        fins, and the gun PRINTS ITS OWN CUTS REPORT: a paper strip rolls out under the coil, is torn off and falls.
cell_note: a bigger cell than the contract's 64: it holds the weapon at every angle with its moving parts thrown out and the toss

equip.note: 18 ticks: up from the hip with a dead lens; at 8 it SPINS UP: the current runs down the coil one ring at a time, the needle lifts, the lens wakes green: ready

idle.note: 1 s loop: the lens breathes a thin green flicker; once a loop the mouth spits a spark that drops to the floor, and the gas bottle sways a pixel

fire.note: 12 ticks a pass, held: tick 0 the shot (every ring of the coil lights, the lens goes white-green, a flash at the mouth, a small kick, the bottle swings back); then the current runs down the coil in green rings, ring after ring toward the lens, and the bottle sways. The ray itself is FX's, from `muzzle`

overheat.note: 60 ticks, its RELOAD SHOW: at 0 the coil goes red-hot, the lens red, the gauge needle slams into the red; at 6 the fins VENT (steam bursts over the coil, 29 px ahead of the grip) and the gun prints its own cuts report: a paper strip rolls out of a slot under the coil, longer and longer, is torn off and falls; the coil cools ring by ring, the lens wakes green: ready

empty.note: 12 ticks: the click on an empty bottle (the lens dies, the needle drops to zero), a droop; at 6 he tosses it away in front of him, nose down, the tag trailing

catch.note: the hand-off from the unarmed catch (catch.json has the body's frames): it lands dead in his hands, spins up, the lens wakes; the reveal from the last frame

aim_note: a frame's aim = degrees the weapon turns from its rest (the idle's first frame is 0), added to the body's aim; kick = [px along the barrel (negative = back), px up, degrees up]
mark: the made-in-Israel mark as a SMALL HANGING TAG (the Host 12.11: at most 9 x 11, the beta's pattern): an ivory luggage tag with the blue outline star 7 x 7 on a 3 px blue-and-white cord from a swivel under the coil, 29 px ahead of the grip (clear of both heroes' bodies); upright and whole in every row, swinging by whole pixels with the shot, the bottle and the toss. In atlas_mark.png ONLY (the Host's ruling)
mark_rect_note: per angle row, per column: [x, y, w, h] of the mark in the cell (the 9 x 11 tag, or the 11 x 11 roundel) and mark_star = the top-left pixel of the star (7 x 7 on the tag, 9 x 9 on a roundel); atlas_mark.png holds the mark alone in the same layout

events.draw: the rifle comes up from the hip (arsenal.json equip 0)
events.spin_up: the coil spins up (equip 8): a rising whine, the rings light one by one
events.ready: the act is over on this frame's last tick: can fire
events.anticipation: the 1-tick squash, on the shot's own tick (fire 0)
events.shot: the ray (fire 0, repeated every pass while held): FX's beam from `muzzle`, along the row's angle; the lens and every coil ring are lit on this frame
events.overheat: overheat (overheat 0): a hiss, the coil red-hot, the needle in the red
events.vent: the fins vent (overheat 6): a steam burst over the coil, the printer starts (a dot-matrix chatter)
events.click: the trigger on an empty bottle (empty 0)
events.toss: the spent rifle leaves his hand (empty 6)
events.reveal: RENDER fires the reveal from this pose

normal_note: by plane: every colour paints one plane of the weapon (top, front, underside ...), turned with the row; silhouette pixels face out along the edge; the upright mark faces the viewer

holds.note: THE SET'S OWN CARRY per hero body pose (the Host 12.11: a hero's face is never covered by his weapon in any pose). While the king plays one of these body animations with this weapon, draw the weapon at `aim` (degrees, the body's hand aim replaced) and its hand point moved by `offset` [x, y] px; the frame's own aim delta and kick still add. His port carry (aim 25-40) puts a long weapon across his chin and mouth; a low hip carry at -20 keeps the face and the crown clear (picture: art/weapons/host/previews/king_carry_long_weapons.png).

muzzle_note: the lens mouth's centre on the barrel's axis, per row and column: the beam starts here; the lens is lit in every fire frame, so FX may start its ray on any of them

glow.note: the beam's own colours as drawn in the lens and the coil: green ray, white-green core; red when overheated

cells: the canopy flat on the floor
sprites.anchor: the cell's TOP-left at `at` (frame px; the sprite stands on the cell's bottom, centred)

catch.note: the weapon's side of the unarmed set's catch, on the same ticks and hand points as the shotgun's catch.json (the body is one builder's): frames 0-2 it comes down, 3 the catch (its grip lands on the hand), 3-4 what carried it lets go, 5-6 in the hands, 7-9 held up behind his head (layer back), the reveal from 9. Its carrier is the parachute: on the catch it folds, then lies on the floor.
